Stage A's 174->129 structural / 45 chord-blind / 12-promoted classification is a prose-rationale judgment call (per-negative 'projection'/'chord_could_differ'/'priority' fields), not a computed procedure with a committed script; the campaign's headline '74% structurally immune' bound rests on this classification.

red_flags.detail: CP-S032A's own verify_note admits one of its two claimed geometric checks ('mirror_equals_conjugation... verified m=1..4') is a tautology that holds for any invertible matrix and does not actually test the amphichirality claim it was offered to support; verdict is still judged HARDENS on the strength of the other, non-material-dependent argument (finite-orbit symmetrization).

arcs.seat_note: This is a genuine methodological audit (re-testing the arc's own prior negatives at a finer theta-odd/chord level with an explicit anti-self-deception discipline, the 'W3-082c trap' for abelian-invariant-relabeled-as-chord), and the 12 Stage-B cells are backed by committed, re-runnable code and witnesses, which is unusually strong practice for this repo. It is entirely a self-consistency/robustness exercise over pre-existing group-theoretic and trace-field structure (no measurable physical quantity is computed or predicted here), and the one numeric-only 'identically zero' claim (CP-E5-chiral) would benefit from an exact symbolic proof rather than 1e-14-level floating-point evidence.
